present for the State.

entities.text:
Devyani International Limited & Others vs State Of Uttarakhand
& Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: By means of present criminal writ petition, the petitioners seek to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned order dated 04.12.2014 passed by Adjudicating Officer/ADM, Haridwar in case no.7 of 2014.

The principal submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not been constituted in the State as yet and therefore, the petitioner cannot challenge the impugned order of the adjudicating Officer before the said Tribunal.
This Court was taken through the provisions of Sections 46(4), 68, 70, 71(6), 22 and 24 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court was also taken through the provisions of the Rules 3.1.1.8, 3.1.1.9 and 3.1.1.12 of the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.
It is the statement of learned Deputy Advocate General that the establishment of Food Safety Appellate Tribunals at Dehradun and Haldwani is in the offing and shall become functional very soon.
No purpose will be served by keeping the present writ petition pending in view of the above statement of learned counsel for the State.

Criminal Writ Petition is thus disposed of by directing the petitioner to approach Food Safety Appellate Tribunal having jurisdiction within a month from the date the same becomes functional and till then the impugned order shall remain in abeyance.

(U. C. Dhyani, J.) Dated 25.03.2015 Rawat Devyani International Limited & Others vs State Of Uttarakhand & Another on 25 March, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31719388/
